systems.system: National Public Key Infrastructure (NIMC Root Certification Authority)

systems.tiers: government agencies, banks, businesses via secure APIs

note: The NIMC Act 2026 is an identity law (class other); the Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill (approved by the House by May 2026, awaiting the Senate) is described only for e-signatures and paperless records (ss 16-18, 44-46), not for public bodies exchanging data, so no fact. The NIMC Act empowering NIMC to build data-sharing systems across public institutions is noted only.
